source_checks.requirement: Q5: Does this preview provide live leads, guaranteed rankings, or verified projects?
source_checks.evidence: A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS Clarity, from the start. Who is MBRACE INSIGHT for? + HVAC owners and operators evaluating how to improve local visibility, prepare for commercial work, or make their business processes clearer. This initial concept focuses on Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Is this a lead list or a live opportunity feed? + This preview presents a research and qualification approach. It does not provide a live lead feed or verified project inventory. Public building data is a starting point; project need, timing, authority, and permission need separate confirmation. What happens when I build a brief? + Your selections generate a starting framework in this browser. You can download it as a text file. Nothing is sent to MBRACE, and the brief does not represent a completed audit or a subscription. How much does it cost, and how do I start? + This preview does not publish pricing. Start with the free browser-local planning framework, or contact Max Fisher at mfisher@mbraceinsight.com to discuss a proposed scope. Any paid work requires an agreed scope and fee; the planner does not create a purchase or subscription. Does Insight guarantee rankings or project wins? + No. The approach helps an operator investigate and qualify a next step. It does not guarantee search rankings, calls, revenue, contractor availability, or awarded projects. Sources and evidence support a claim; they do not turn a forecast into a result. Can homeowners use MBRACE INSIGHT? + Insight focuses on the HVAC business. The MBRACE Energy journey is intended for homeowners and building decision-makers. Keeping these paths distinct helps each audience find the right kind of support.
